title: Decision EE-104: anticipation replaces precog in the ontology
body:
Adds to `docs/ontology.json`: anticipation (Mentura's anticipatory capability after Rosen 1985, narrowed; people decide, nothing commits the venture), impact forecast (narrower than forecast and anticipation), decision prefetch, forecast, scoped senses capability@function (owned by capabilities) and capability@product (owned by products), and a causal `driver-of` relation seeded with three links the ontology already supports. Retires precog with a pointer to anticipation (Minority Report connotations of surveillance and pre-judgment). Appends decision EE-104, including the internal codename Deluminator; the public name is still Torian's to choose.

`docs/ontology.md` and `docs/noun-graph.md` regenerated; `node test.mjs` passes.

Stacked on #157 (base `cursor/noun-relations-graph-0d5a`); retargets to main once #157 merges. Follow-up: `site/content/marketing/how.mdx` and `site/scripts/artifact.mjs` still say Precog, left until the public name is chosen.

Built by cloud agent bc-9758ee81 (its PR tool failed with `[unavailable] Error`, so this was opened by Grok Bot at Torian's direction).
